comparison.objective: Candidate removes an electrical terminal; record disconnects a pneumatic tube and blanks its port.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate inserts a thin blade under an internal tab while pulling the wire and tool together; record closes a valve, depresses a collet, extracts tubing, and inserts a plug.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective terminal removal without damage or unintended release; record requires valve-first disconnection and a seated, released blanking plug.
comparison.reason: The push-to-connect collet sequence and subsequent port blanking are materially different despite a shared release-before-pull pattern.
